reviews.name: Daijob.com
reviews.note: Languages verified from the English home page. The Tokyo office address (Shinjuku) is on biz.daijob.com/about but no headquarters statement, so hq_country is not recorded. Corp page corp.daijob.com returned 403 and the headless reader reported it blocked, so founded and parent could not be checked there. Footer names Human Resocia Co., Ltd. as copyright holder only, which is not recorded as parent. Prices are behind a request form on biz.daijob.com/price, so business_model is not recorded. Only a Japanese-language sub-page was used for pricing.

reviews.name: TESL Canada
reviews.note: Ingest by email and the Fredericton, NB mailing address verified on jobs.html. Founding year not stated on about-us.html or jobs.html; the only year is a 2015 copyright line, which is not a founding date.

reviews.name: lavoro.gov.it (Ministry of Labour)
reviews.note: Country inferred from the Italian government link on the home page. Ministry history page read with fetch: no founding date or seat. No job posting or ingest information on the pages read. Cliclavoro (http://www.cliclavoro.gov.it/) was not used as a source because it is outside this entry's domain. Site shows SIISL as a system label only, with no description of job ingest.
